# Source: Remembrance of Italy

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Remembrance of Italy
- **Artist / culture:** Jean-Baptiste-Camille Corot (French, 1796-1875) printed by Auguste Delâtre (French, 1822-1907) published by Cadart et Chavalier, Editeurs (French, 1801-1900)
- **Date:** c. 1866
- **Style:** Unspecified
- **Classification:** etching
- **Department:** Prints and Drawings
- **AIC artwork ID:** 27
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/27
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/ab107179-7106-937e-7676-e0263b02e530/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Expressionism

## Extracted source palette

`#D8B888, #A88858, #383828, #C8A868, #685838, #886848, #D8D8C8, #D8C8A8`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#1D1D15`
- `surface`: `#373730`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#D8B888`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#685838`
- `surface_variant`: `#373730`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#5A5A54`
- `error`: `#D8B888`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `serif` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `6dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `15.94:1`, surface `11.27:1`
- Variant contrast: `11.27:1`
- Control contrast: `10.36:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
